product_one_liner.value: Upstage builds large language models and document-processing engines to help enterprises automate business workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes large language models and document-processing engines for transforming business workflows: https://www.upstage.ai/.

pricing_page.notes: Upstage has a public page presenting pricing plans: https://www.upstage.ai/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Upstage's customer-success page names Amwins and Chosun Ilbo in product-use case studies, rather than as investors or partners: https://www.upstage.ai/customers. | named_customers.0: The customer-success page identifies Amwins in a document-extraction case study. | named_customers.1: The customer-success page identifies Chosun Ilbo as using Solar Pro for its translation pipeline.

employee_band.notes: Dealroom explicitly lists 201–500 employees (https://app.dealroom.co/companies/upstage_1), consistent with Upstage's Korean about page describing more than 200 researchers, engineers and business leaders (https://www.upstage.ai/ko/about). The exact band relies on a secondary source.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: PitchBook explicitly identifies Seoul as Upstage's headquarters city: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/454835-53. | hq_country: PitchBook identifies the headquarters as Seoul, South Korea: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/454835-53. This is a secondary-source headquarters designation.

founded_year.notes: Upstage's about page explicitly states that it was founded in 2020: https://www.upstage.ai/about.

eng_blog.notes: Two posts explain Upstage's implementation: WriteUp quantization and engine optimization (https://upstage.ai/blog/en/on-device-writeup), and TFLOP's layout-pointer approach (https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/ai-powered-table-recognition-just-got-smarter). WriteUp coauthor Jaeho Lee is an Upstage software engineer (https://linkedin.com/in/jaeho-lee-5637a214); the TFLOP post's authors include Upstage research authors Minsoo Khang and Teakgyu Hong (https://arxiv.org/html/2501.11800v1). Qualification requires combining content, bylines and author identities.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal includes Getting Started, Models, Deployment Options and an API reference, exceeding a single FAQ: https://developers.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Engineer – LLM Serving Platform posting has an application link and a qualifying AI/LLM title: https://careers.upstage.ai/en/o/215818.

model_provider.notes: Upstage calls Solar its proprietary LLM (https://upstage.ai/blog/en/on-device-writeup), and its documentation states that the available production models are developed by Upstage (https://developers.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started).

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The on-premises pricing page explicitly claims SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001/27701 certification. Only the requested certifications are listed: https://www.upstage.ai/pricing/on-premises. | compliance_certs.0: The on-premises pricing page explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The same page explicitly names ISO 27001/27701; ISO 27001 is included in the requested certification set. | compliance_certs.2: The same page explicitly claims HIPAA certification/compliance.

value.stage: Series C Round 2 (ongoing; NVIDIA investment not yet finalized)

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest announcement identifies the financing as ongoing Series C Round 2 and quotes Upstage saying NVIDIA's investment has yet to be finalized. The answer preserves that qualification rather than presenting a completed round: https://www.chosun.com/english/industry-en/2026/11/09/H7PBDSMG2RBBROW6QMZ263ROBE. | funding_date: November 2026 is the announcement month of NVIDIA's participation in Series C Round 2, not a confirmed closing month; the article explicitly says finalization is pending: https://www.chosun.com/english/industry-en/2026/11/09/H7PBDSMG2RBBROW6QMZ263ROBE. | funding_amount_usd: The latest announced NVIDIA participation in the ongoing Series C round has no disclosed investment amount, so its USD amount is unknown. The earlier April tranche's amount must not be substituted: https://en.fnnews.com/news/202611091915255020.

raised_18mo.notes: The dated company announcement establishes a completed $45 million Series B bridge on August 20, 2025, within the requested 18-month window, independently of the pending NVIDIA investment: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/upstage-completes-45m-series-b-bridge-to-accelerate-enterprise-grade-genai-and-global-expansion-302534044.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live posting titled SDR (Sales Development Representative, 계약직 1년) includes an application link: https://careers.upstage.ai/en/o/226753.

launched_6mo.notes: Upstage announced the next generation of Upstage Studio on October 6, 2026, within the requested six-month window. This is a product-platform launch rather than a minor fix: https://www.upstage.ai/news/upstage-launches-studio-advancing-intelligent-document-processing-from-data-extraction-to-business-action.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A March 6, 2026 report says Upstage recently recruited Jin Yoon-jung as CFO, establishing a C-level appointment within the requested 12-month window. It does not give the exact joining day: https://www.fnnews.com/news/202603061631389629.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Upstage's privacy policy explicitly lists Salesforce, Attio and Apollo as subcontractors, providing a direct public signal of use: https://www.upstage.ai/privacy-policy/updated-mar-25-2026. | crm_stack_signal.0: The official privacy policy names Salesforce.com, Inc. as a subcontractor. | crm_stack_signal.1: The official privacy policy names Attio Ltd. as a subcontractor. | crm_stack_signal.2: The official privacy policy names Apollo.io, Inc. as a subcontractor.
